notes: Whole-file digests for everything CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 was forbidden to change.

This phase moves one lifecycle boundary in core/pipeline.py and adds one pure reducer. Every evidence producer it orchestrates - DEFECT.PROBE.LIVE.3, OPS.PATCH.2, OPS.VALIDATE.3, VALIDATE.ORACLE.LIVE.1 - is pinned here, together with EXEC.POLICY.LIVE.1, EXEC.APPROVAL.LIVE.1 and EXEC.AUTH.LIVE.1, so verification cannot have been achieved by weakening any of them.

safe_minimal lives in patching/patch_gates.py and policy/decision_helper.py: both are pinned, because the phase's whole point is that shape safety correctly accepts the known wrong T6 candidate and semantic rejection belongs elsewhere.
core/code_dna.py is pinned because _classify_indent stays deliberately broken; verification measures it and does not repair it.
OPS.VALIDATE.3's selector and command selection are pinned so 'targeted validation now engages' means it engages unchanged.

PATCH.MINIMAL.LIVE.2 re-pinned patching/patch_gates.py from 816101991102f593cd037ec2009ddbfb3936b6ceb004dd839a1584e01434425e to cec73583c9d416e3b4f883090b02f2b48e0b012c44d2962f5e40819a5c070cf7. CANDIDATE.VERIFY.LIVE.1 pinned safe_minimal to show that shape safety accepts the known wrong T6 candidate and that semantic rejection belongs to verification. That claim survives the widening unchanged - the wrong reorder candidate still passes shape safety and is still rejected by verification - and LIVE.2 adds no path by which a candidate can reach verification with a weaker verdict. policy/decision_helper.py, the other half of the safe_minimal pin, is unchanged.
patch_author_live2_repin_note: PATCH.AUTHOR.LIVE.2 (2026-09-10) is the phase authorised to move the patch-authoring contract: the candidate wire shape, the exact field names, the output-only rules and the safe_minimal identifier constraints now live in core/patch_authoring_contract.py, and the initial draft and the single verification-guided revision both render from there. core/control_engine.py moved for that reason and for no other. The initial-draft prompt is byte-identical across 82 configurations, and tests/fixtures/patch_author_live2_contract_reversal.json stores the hunks that reverse the change, so a test reconstructs the pre-LIVE.2 bytes from the shipped file and asserts the digest this note replaced.
